text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser pulled off a splendid 
victory! Though the crowd was taken by 
surprise, many voices rose up in praise of 
her hardworking nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower 
stood in the underground tunnel. The two 
praised one another and promised to race 
again in the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After returning home, at 
Matikanetannhauser's suggestion, the next 
major goal was set as the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to fit in a long-distance race 
before spring, her next target race was 
set as the Diamond Stakes!
